title: Hands Free Harvesting
description:
Harvesting a large field means walking over hundreds of dropped items.

The **Pickup Upgrade** sends anything you walk over straight into the backpack. The **Magnet Upgrade** goes further and pulls items in from a distance — you never touch them at all.

Both can be filtered, so you can collect wheat and ignore seeds.

For a farm selling by the stack, this is the difference between harvesting and doing inventory management.

objectives.name: Craft a Pickup or Magnet Upgrade
